title: Resolution to grant tax break for MHANY Bronx housing cluster
summary: This resolution approves a property tax exemption for an MHANY Bronx Cluster housing development at several lots in the Bronx, under state law covering housing development fund companies. The exemption would run for up to 40 years from the effective date and can end early if the owner violates program rules. It replaces any prior tax exemption on the same property.
